name: drive_list_files
description: List files in your Google Drive. Optionally filter by name, type, owner, or modified date (e.g., 'name contains "report"'). Returns file names, IDs, types, and metadata.

page_size.description: Maximum number of files to return (default 10, max 100)

page_token.description: Token for fetching the next page of results

name: drive_get_file
description: Get metadata for a specific Drive file by ID. Returns name, type, size, owners, permissions, creation date, and last modified time.

file_id.description: The ID of the file to retrieve

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include (default: id,name,mimeType,size,createdTime,modifiedTime,owners,webViewLink)

name: drive_get_content
description: Download file content from Drive. Export Google Docs/Sheets/Slides to PDF, Word, Excel, etc., or retrieve raw content from other files.

file_id.description: The ID of the file to download

export_mime_type.description: MIME type to export Google Workspace files to (e.g., "text/plain", "application/pdf", "text/csv"). Required for Google Docs/Sheets/Slides.

name: drive_create_file
description: Create a new file in Drive with specified name, content, and type (e.g., 'text/plain', 'application/pdf'). Returns the file ID for future reference.

parent_folder_id.description: ID of the parent folder (optional, defaults to root)

name: drive_search
description: Search Drive files by name, type, owner, modified date, or full text using query operators (e.g., 'name contains "report"', 'mimeType = application/pdf'). Returns matching files and IDs.

query.description: Drive search query (e.g., "fullText contains 'quarterly report'" or "modifiedTime > '2024-01-01'")
